trades.name: LBAF of 7760-7764
trades.quote: Given we have held 7760-7764 twice into the close, I suppose a LBAF would work as along. Doing so would assume that we are to see direct continuation higher.

trades.name: Persistent weakness below 7760-7764 (structure repair)
trades.quote: Given how thin today’s structure is and how many shorts (many of whom were short calls intraday) were carted out, we once again have a chance of seeing a “structure repair mission” on persistent weakness below 7760-7764. Like for today, we just need to be prepared to flip long. The session needs to be in a persistent downtrend with volume building lower and lower for me to consider holding a short.
